nodes.label: Rundale Bench v1-dev Dataset Manifest
nodes.rationale: An unfrozen 309-record manifest tracks development and holdout files across dialogue, Gaeilge, intent, reaction, tier-2 simulation, and tier-3 simulation.

nodes.label: Merkle and SHA-256 Dataset Integrity
nodes.rationale: Each slice records its SHA-256, record count, and byte size beneath a manifest Merkle root so dataset drift is detectable.
